title: My Vanilla
description: My version of a lovely vanilla experience.
body:
This modpack takes the classic Minecraft survival experience and gives it a challenging, immersive upgrade. It stays close to vanilla but introduces smarter enemies, tougher survival mechanics, improved biomes, and a greater sense of progression without losing the familiar feel of the original game.

The world feels more alive adding Subtle visual and sound improvements add atmosphere without breaking immersion, and lightweight performance tweaks ensure the game still runs smoothly.
